title: When the Archive Falls Anew
author: Theo Sterling
blurb: Bram Villalobos, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
